# nd_vpc_pair (Data Source)

Reads a configured vPC pair from a fabric.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_vpc_pair" "test_datasource_vpc_pair_1" {
  fabric_name = "FABRIC_VXLAN"
  switch_id   = "9U1QYJ2PUAU"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) Name of the fabric containing the vPC pair.
- `switch_id` (String) Serial number of either switch in the vPC pair, used to look up the pair.

### Read-Only

- `peer_switch_id` (String) Serial number of the other switch in the vPC pair.
- `use_virtual_peerlink` (Boolean) Whether the vPC pair uses a virtual peer link.
- `vpc_pair_details` (Attributes) Default-template and peer-link attributes returned for the vPC pair, including keepalive IP addresses. Free-form configuration fields are omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc_pair_details))

<a id="nestedatt--vpc_pair_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpc_pair_details`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state` (Boolean) Administrative state of the peer-link port channel.
- `allowed_vlans` (String) VLANs allowed on the peer-link port channel.
- `domain_id` (Number) vPC domain identifier shared by the peer switches.
- `enable_mirror_config` (Boolean) Whether mirrored configuration generation is enabled for the pair.
- `fabric_path_switch_id` (Number) FabricPath switch identifier used by the vPC pair template.
- `is_vpc_plus` (Boolean) Whether vPC+ mode is enabled for the pair.
- `is_vteps` (Boolean) Whether the paired switches operate as VTEPs.
- `keep_alive_hold_timeout` (Number) Hold timeout for the vPC peer keepalive session.
- `keep_alive_vrf` (String) VRF used for the vPC peer keepalive session.
- `nve_interface` (Number) NVE interface identifier associated with the pair.
- `peer_switch_keep_alive_local_ip` (String) Local keepalive source IP address used on the peer switch.
- `peer_switch_member_interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces on the peer switch that form the peer-link port channel.
- `peer_switch_native_vlan` (Number) Native VLAN on the peer switch peer-link interfaces.
- `peer_switch_po_description` (String) Description of the peer switch peer-link port channel.
- `peer_switch_po_id` (Number) Port-channel identifier for the peer switch peer link.
- `peer_switch_source_loopback` (Number) Source loopback interface number used by the peer switch for keepalive traffic.
- `po_mode` (String) Port-channel mode configured for the peer link.
- `switch_keep_alive_local_ip` (String) Local keepalive source IP address used on the switch.
- `switch_member_interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces on the switch that form the peer-link port channel.
- `switch_native_vlan` (Number) Native VLAN on the switch peer-link interfaces.
- `switch_po_description` (String) Description of the switch peer-link port channel.
- `switch_po_id` (Number) Port-channel identifier for the switch peer link.
- `switch_source_loopback` (Number) Source loopback interface number used by the switch for keepalive traffic.
- `template_type` (String) Template type used for the vPC pair.
